findingDetails.title: The spec's 5l edge-case silence statements are unpinned by the shipped tests
findingDetails.case: A future edit drops the sk-code basename gate or the opencode-absent early return; 5l then prints a line on the six other hubs, or on an sk-code tree without sk-code-opencode, deviating from spec.md:156-158, and no test fails because the clean-fixture case asserts only FAIL/WARN absence plus a fixed PASS-id list.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add two small cases: no 5l line on a non-sk-code hub, and no 5l line on an sk-code tree whose tieBreak lacks sk-code-opencode; optionally pin that 5l ignores a workflow mode after opencode.
